title: Agent = model + harness. Ruflo is the harness for Claude Code and Codex #shorts
description:
An agent is a model plus a harness. The model writes the
code. The harness decides whether any of it gets done.

Ruflo -- formerly Claude Flow -- is the harness layer for
Claude Code and Codex. One npx command gives you 100+
specialist agents that swarm, learn from every task, and
remember across sessions.

Then there's federation, which is the strange one. Your
agents can talk to agents on someone else's machine.
Identity is verified with mTLS and ed25519, personal data is
stripped before anything leaves your node, and every message
is auditable. Trust upgrades as peers behave -- and drops
instantly when they don't.

MIT. 68K stars. 8.1M downloads.

Save it, then run npx ruflo init.
Would you let your agent talk to someone else's?

#aiagents #claudecode #opensource #devtools #mcp
